goal: Produce traceable, human-directed, production-ready creative artifacts while reusing approved foundations and preserving explicit human final authority.
stage_satisfaction_rule: Before executing a stage, check for a current approved non-superseded artifact with matching scope, provenance, and required gate state. If valid, mark SATISFIED_BY_REUSE instead of re-executing. Conditional stages may be SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE. Missing required evidence is BLOCKED.

stages.name: strategy
stages.goal: Convert customer and project inputs into an approved authoritative project definition.
stages.memory_effect: Creates approved project knowledge; never creates external source facts.

stages.name: research
stages.goal: Establish traceable audience, market, cultural, and visual-reference evidence.
stages.memory_effect: Adds sourced project and external evidence; unsupported conclusions remain UNKNOWN.

stages.name: visual_analysis
stages.goal: Describe supplied visual evidence without turning observations into creative decisions.
stages.memory_effect: Creates project-reference observations classified as SOURCE or DERIVED.

stages.name: named_style_study
stages.goal: Understand a named visual language and derive responsible transferable principles.
stages.memory_effect: Adds source-backed style knowledge; interpretation cannot become historical fact.

stages.name: motif_sign_extraction
stages.goal: Extract recurring visual vocabulary while preserving evidence, frequency, and imitation risk.
stages.memory_effect: Creates scoped motif records; motifs remain evidence, not brand decisions.

stages.name: reference_style_synthesis
stages.goal: Translate supplied references and applicable style knowledge into original transferable principles.
stages.memory_effect: Creates project-scoped derived creative knowledge with explicit provenance.

stages.name: visual_dna
stages.goal: Convert validated evidence and style principles into traceable visual-system rules.
stages.memory_effect: Creates candidate project rules; approval scope must remain explicit.

stages.name: platform_template_synthesis
stages.goal: Translate the approved visual system into reusable platform-specific production structure.
stages.memory_effect: Creates reusable structure. A current approved foundation may satisfy stages 01-08 by reuse when scope and provenance match.

stages.name: approved_content_handoff
stages.goal: Resolve approved writing/content and the current creative foundation before content-specific design begins.
stages.memory_effect: Links approved content to the current foundation without changing either.

stages.name: art_direction
stages.goal: Create and approve content-specific creative decisions within strategy, content, and visual-system constraints.
stages.memory_effect: Creates approved content-specific creative decisions; decisions remain distinct from evidence.

stages.name: generation
stages.goal: Operationalize approved direction into an execution specification, model-adapted prompt, and generated candidate.
stages.memory_effect: Creates OUTPUT artifacts only; generated results are candidates, not automatically approved knowledge.

stages.name: human_directed_revision
stages.goal: Apply scoped human-directed corrections while preserving non-authorized content and design.
stages.memory_effect: Records revision evidence only. Reusable learning is not promoted here.

stages.name: pre_final_quality_control
stages.goal: Evaluate the generated or revised candidate before final creative refinement and route root-cause correction.
stages.memory_effect: Records quality evidence and revision routing; critical failures cannot be averaged away.

stages.name: final_ai_creative_refinement
stages.goal: Run the controlled late-stage creative refinement and Heavy-QC closed loop without granting final human approval.
stages.memory_effect: Produces final-refinement evidence and preserves approved meaning; FINAL-AI protocols are not task contracts in this version.

stages.name: editable_reconstruction_preparation
stages.goal: Prepare an approved flattened or raster candidate for faithful editable reconstruction while preserving source lock.
stages.memory_effect: Records reconstruction derivations without replacing the approved visual source.

stages.name: editable_implementation
stages.goal: Build the approved design as a structured editable production master when the deliverable requires one.
stages.memory_effect: Records implementation provenance; implementation cannot silently redefine approved art direction.

stages.name: final_production_quality_control
stages.goal: Validate the final production representation after refinement and any editable reconstruction or implementation.
stages.memory_effect: Confirms that production transformation has not invalidated the approved candidate.

stages.name: human_final_approval
stages.goal: Reserve final creative authority for explicit human approval after all applicable machine gates pass.
stages.memory_effect: Creates the authoritative final approval decision; AI cannot self-promote a candidate to final publishing master.

stages.name: master_platform_derivatives
stages.goal: Preserve the approved archival/project master and create platform derivatives once from that master.
stages.memory_effect: Records final output relationships; derivatives never replace the approved master as provenance.

stages.name: learning_memory_promotion
stages.goal: Synthesize final QC/revision evidence and promote only human-authorized reusable learning at the correct scope.
stages.memory_effect: Promotes only traceable, scoped, human-authorized knowledge; one-off corrections remain project evidence unless explicitly elevated.
